assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create the FINAL replacement cover image for a Chinese browser game called 魂斗罗2026, faithful to the original 1988 NES/Famicom Contra TITLE SCREEN / pixel game visual language, not modern realistic art. Square composition 1024x1024, crisp meticulously hand-placed 8-bit pixel art, restricted NES palette, hard pixel edges, no antialiasing, no 3D, no painterly gradients. Deep black navy background. Top 45 percent dominated by enormous custom metallic beveled red-to-orange pixel Chinese title exactly '魂斗罗' with large gold pixel '2026' just below; strong recognizable classic CONTRA arcade angular logo energy. Small white monospace subtitle exactly 'ONLINE CO-OP'. Bottom 55 percent depicts two athletic pixel commandos, one wearing red pants and red headband, one wearing blue pants and blue headband, bare armed tactical heroes holding rifles, standing back to back on mossy layered orange-brown rocky jungle cliffs. Dense graphic emerald jungle silhouettes, bright cobalt river with pixel white ripples at bottom, one small distant gray enemy fortress with red weak-point core on right, orange muzzle flashes. Hero bodies built with real low-resolution sprite geometry, attractive at thumbnail size. Black negative space around logo, strong silhouette, limited tiny details. Original Contra jungle game-screen composition and 1980s pixel typography; no KONAMI logo, no copyright text, no menu buttons, no extra words, no collage, no phone/device frame. Preserve legibility of exact title '魂斗罗2026' as the most dominant element. This is a single cover artwork ready to use in a game collection.

Use case: stylized-concept / game level design. Create a polished, production-ready FIRST LEVEL DESIGN BOARD for the browser game '魂斗罗2026'. The visual reference is the ORIGINAL 1988 NES/Famicom CONTRA first jungle level GAME SCREEN, STRICT 8-BIT PIXEL ART, not modern vector illustration, not 3D, not a watercolor scene. Landscape board 1536x1024. Deep near-black background, restrained professional layout. At top left small cream pixel title exactly '魂斗罗2026' and at top right 'STAGE 01 / JUNGLE FORTRESS'. Main upper 72% is one very large coherent playable horizontal side-scrolling gameplay viewport at roughly 16:9 aspect ratio, with subtle white pixel HUD integrated along its top: '1P 002400' on left with three tiny red life icons, 'HI 020000' centered, '2P 001800' on right with three tiny blue life icons. In this gameplay viewport show classic dense layered deep emerald jungle foliage behind terraced rusty orange and brown textured rock cliffs edged with bright lime moss. Cobalt blue river with white pixel ripples across bottom. A clearly defined walkable upper rock ledge on left, lower ledge halfway, an exploding segmented metal bridge over the central river with a couple orange blast pixels, a second rock ledge on right, and a tall gray-blue mechanical gate fortress on far right with two weapon ports and one red-orange glowing core. Include two independent playable small 8-bit commando sprites: red headband/red pants 1P at left firing diagonally, blue headband/blue pants 2P a little right doing a curled somersault jump; distinct red/blue tiny player tags directly above each sprite. Small olive enemy soldier on right ledge, chest-height white-orange enemy bullets, a flying winged pickup marked 'S' near middle. Logical playable collision silhouettes with terrain not just decorative rocks. Crisp pixel grid and NES limited palette, no soft airbrush, no photorealism, no antialiasing. Bottom 22% is a clean horizontal MINIATURE LEVEL ROUTE STRIP, continuous side-view map of the whole first level left to right, divided by six tiny numbered markers: '01 DROP', '02 CLIFF', '03 BRIDGE', '04 RIVER', '05 TURRETS', '06 FORTRESS'. Thin gold progress line beneath, small red and blue square markers in the same camera bracket labeled 'SHARED CAMERA'. Tiny palette swatches near lower right: black, dark green, bright green, rock brown, cobalt, white, player red, player blue. Keep all type legible but secondary to the gameplay viewport. This is a visual design specification image; no frame of a monitor or controller, no unrelated logos, no modern UI cards, no huge text overlay on gameplay. The first level must feel immediately like the classic Contra jungle with river, rock steps, destructible bridge and enemy base, while original assets and exact Chinese game title are used.
